from pathlib import Path
import json,datetime,hashlib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor,export_text
base=Path.cwd()
out=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_joint_score_v1'
source=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_event_source_contract_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'result.json').exists() and not (out/'逐原公告联合评分.csv').exists(),'单次固定研究不重跑'
for p in protocol['source_receipts']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((base/p['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['sha256'],p['path']
def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime.datetime)):return v.isoformat()
    if isinstance(v,np.generic):return clean(v.item())
    if isinstance(v,float) and not np.isfinite(v):return None
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,(list,tuple)):return [clean(x) for x in v]
    return v
def save(name,v):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
events=pd.read_parquet(source/'全部52原根公告_同原构成与原八状态_无收益标签.parquet')
evals=events[events.era.isin(['2021—2023','2024—2025'])].copy().sort_values('decision_at').reset_index(drop=True)
supports=json.loads((source/'全部51评估公告_相同成熟池支持.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
support={x['event_id']:x for x in supports}
label_source=base/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet'
labels=pd.read_parquet(label_source,columns=['idx','exit_idx','net_label'],filters=[('idx','in',evals.state_idx.astype(int).tolist())]).set_index('idx')
assert len(labels)==len(evals)==51 and labels.net_label.notna().all()
for _,r in evals.iterrows():assert int(labels.loc[int(r.state_idx),'exit_idx'])==int(r.exit_idx)
evals['actual_net5']=evals.state_idx.map(labels.net_label)
evals['entry_at']=pd.to_datetime(evals.entry_date).dt.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')+pd.Timedelta(hours=9,minutes=30)
evals['exit_at']=pd.to_datetime(evals.exit_date).dt.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')+pd.Timedelta(hours=9,minutes=30)
evals.to_parquet(out/'全部51原公告_标签复用与预热保留.parquet',index=False)
base_features=protocol['features_state']
joint_features=protocol['features_joint']
added=protocol['features_new']
def score(fitted,pred):
    return float(100*(np.mean(fitted<pred)+.5*np.mean(fitted==pred)))
def fit_tree(pool,cur,fields):
    x=pool[fields].to_numpy(float);y=pool.actual_net5.to_numpy(float);current=cur[fields].to_numpy(float).reshape(1,-1)
    model=DecisionTreeRegressor(**protocol['tree']).fit(x,y)
    pred=float(model.predict(current)[0]);fitted=model.predict(x);t=model.tree_
    nodes=model.decision_path(current).indices
    actual=[]
    for n in nodes:
        j=int(t.feature[n])
        if j>=0:
            actual.append({'node':int(n),'feature':fields[j],'value':float(current[0,j]),'threshold':float(t.threshold[n]),'direction':'left' if current[0,j]<=t.threshold[n] else 'right'})
    saved={'features':fields,'children_left':t.children_left.tolist(),'children_right':t.children_right.tolist(),'feature':t.feature.tolist(),'threshold':t.threshold.tolist(),'value':t.value.ravel().tolist(),'samples':t.n_node_samples.tolist(),'current_path':actual,'current_leaf':int(model.apply(current)[0]),'used_features':sorted({fields[j] for j in t.feature if j>=0}),'text':export_text(model,feature_names=fields,decimals=6),'fitted_pool_predictions':fitted.tolist()}
    return pred,score(fitted,pred),saved
def fit_ridge(pool,cur,fields):
    x=pool[fields].to_numpy(float);y=pool.actual_net5.to_numpy(float)
    mean=x.mean(axis=0);scale=x.std(axis=0,ddof=1);scale[scale<1e-12]=1.
    z=np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-5,5);zm=z.mean(axis=0);centered=z-zm;ym=float(y.mean())
    coef=np.linalg.solve(centered.T@centered+10*np.eye(len(fields)),centered.T@(y-ym))
    fitted=ym+centered@coef
    pred=float(ym+(np.clip((cur[fields].to_numpy(float)-mean)/scale,-5,5)-zm)@coef)
    return pred,score(fitted,pred),{'features':fields,'mean':mean.tolist(),'scale':scale.tolist(),'zmean':zm.tolist(),'coef':coef.tolist(),'ymean':ym,'alpha':10,'fitted_pool_predictions':fitted.tolist()}
predictions=[];models=[];unscored=[]
for _,cur in evals.iterrows():
    sp=support[cur.event_id]
    pool=evals[(evals.state_idx>=cur.state_idx-504)&(evals.state_idx<cur.state_idx)&(evals.exit_idx<=cur.state_idx)]
    assert pool.event_id.tolist()==sp['training_event_ids'] and pool.state_idx.astype(int).tolist()==sp['training_state_indices']
    assert cur.event_support_complete and pool.event_support_complete.all()
    if sp['status']!='READY_FOR_SEPARATE_MODEL_REGISTRATION':
        unscored.append(sp)
        continue
    assert len(pool)>=12 and pool.exit_at.le(cur.decision_at).all() and cur.entry_at>cur.decision_at
    row=cur.to_dict();row.update(training_events=len(pool),training_event_ids=';'.join(pool.event_id),training_max_exit_idx=int(pool.exit_idx.max()))
    modelrow={'event_id':cur.event_id,'decision_at':cur.decision_at,'training_event_ids':pool.event_id.tolist(),'training_labels':pool.actual_net5.tolist(),'models':{}}
    for name,fields,func in [('state8_tree',base_features,fit_tree),('joint11_tree',joint_features,fit_tree),('state8_ridge',base_features,fit_ridge),('joint11_ridge',joint_features,fit_ridge)]:
        pred,sc,m=func(pool,cur,fields)
        row[name+'_prediction']=pred;row[name+'_score']=sc;modelrow['models'][name]=m
    row['same_pool_mean_prediction']=float(pool.actual_net5.mean());row['same_pool_mean_score']=50.
    paths=modelrow['models']['joint11_tree']['current_path']
    row['added_fields_on_actual_path']=any(p['feature'] in added for p in paths)
    row['joint_actual_path_features']=';'.join(p['feature'] for p in paths)
    predictions.append(row);models.append(modelrow)
pred=pd.DataFrame(predictions)
assert len(pred)==protocol['expected_scored_events']==39
assert int(pred.era.eq('2024—2025').sum())==protocol['expected_primary_scored_events']==22
pred.to_csv(out/'逐原公告联合评分.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pred.to_parquet(out/'逐原公告联合评分.parquet',index=False)
save('全部39次保存模型与实际决策路径.json',models)
save('全部12预热事件保留.json',unscored)
def summary(values):
    a=np.asarray(values,dtype=float);n=len(a);pos=a[a>0];neg=a[a<0]
    return {'n':n,'mean_net5':float(a.mean()) if n else None,'median_net5':float(np.median(a)) if n else None,'win_rate':float((a>0).mean()) if n else None,'payoff':float(pos.mean()/-neg.mean()) if len(pos) and len(neg) else None}
opps=[];bins=[];errors=[]
for model in protocol['models']:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        block=pred[pred.era.eq(era)]
        errors.append({'era':era,'model':model,'n':len(block),'mse':float(np.mean((block[model+'_prediction']-block.actual_net5)**2)),'mae':float(np.mean(np.abs(block[model+'_prediction']-block.actual_net5)))})
        bands=np.minimum(np.floor(block[model+'_score']/20).astype(int),4)
        for b in range(5):
            bins.append({'era':era,'model':model,'score_band':f'{20*b}—{20*(b+1)}',**summary(block.loc[bands.eq(b),'actual_net5'])})
for model in ['state8_tree','joint11_tree']:
    next_allowed=pd.Timestamp('1900-01-01',tz='Asia/Shanghai')
    for _,r in pred.iterrows():
        if r.decision_at<next_allowed or r[model+'_score']<80 or r[model+'_prediction']<=0:continue
        opps.append({'model':model,'event_id':r.event_id,'era':r.era,'signal_date':r.decision_at,'entry_date':r.entry_date,'exit_date':r.exit_date,'score':r[model+'_score'],'prediction':r[model+'_prediction'],'net_return':r.actual_net5,'state_idx':int(r.state_idx),'exit_idx':int(r.exit_idx),'source_url':r.source_url,'stat_period_end':r.stat_period_end,'added_fields_on_actual_path':bool(r.added_fields_on_actual_path) if model=='joint11_tree' else False,'joint_actual_path_features':r.joint_actual_path_features if model=='joint11_tree' else ''})
        next_allowed=r.exit_at
op=pd.DataFrame(opps,columns=['model','event_id','era','signal_date','entry_date','exit_date','score','prediction','net_return','state_idx','exit_idx','source_url','stat_period_end','added_fields_on_actual_path','joint_actual_path_features'])
op.to_csv(out/'全部固定高分自然机会.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
sums=[];annual=[]
for model in ['state8_tree','joint11_tree']:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        sub=op[op.model.eq(model)&op.era.eq(era)]
        sums.append({'model':model,'era':era,**summary(sub.net_return)})
    for y in range(2021,2026):
        sub=op[op.model.eq(model)&pd.to_datetime(op.entry_date).dt.year.eq(y)]
        annual.append({'model':model,'entry_year':y,**summary(sub.net_return)})
for name,values in [('同事件全部五档比较.csv',bins),('全部五模型误差.csv',errors),('两树高分机会比较.csv',sums),('高分自然机会按入场年计数.csv',annual)]:
    pd.DataFrame(values).to_csv(out/name,index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
primary_errors={e['model']:e for e in errors if e['era']=='2024—2025'}
primary_joint=op[op.model.eq('joint11_tree')&op.era.eq('2024—2025')]
primary_state=op[op.model.eq('state8_tree')&op.era.eq('2024—2025')]
new_dates=sorted(set(pd.to_datetime(primary_joint.entry_date).dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))-set(pd.to_datetime(primary_state.entry_date).dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')))
gates={'G1':primary_errors['joint11_tree']['mse']<=primary_errors['state8_tree']['mse'],'G2':primary_errors['joint11_tree']['mse']<=primary_errors['same_pool_mean']['mse'],'G3':len(primary_joint)>0 and primary_joint.net_return.mean()>0,'G4':len(primary_joint)>=len(primary_state) and len(new_dates)>=1,'G5':bool(primary_joint.added_fields_on_actual_path.any())}
passed=all(gates.values())
save('主要期固定五门_不择优.json',{'definitions':protocol['fixed_primary_gates'],'passed':gates,'all_passed':passed,'primary_new_entry_dates':new_dates,'primary_joint_n':len(primary_joint),'primary_state_n':len(primary_state)})
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E45','completed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),'status':'SIGNAL_INCREMENT_PASSED_PENDING_SEPARATE_ACCOUNT_PROTOCOL' if passed else 'REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_COMPOSITION_JOINT_SCORE_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT','classification':'PROGRESS_E44_COMPLETE_KNOWN_ORIGINAL_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_AND_E45_ONESHOT_MATCHED_EVENT_SCORE','source_gate':'PASS_KNOWN_ORIGINAL_EVENT_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_AND_CLOCK_CONTRACT','known_event_roots_preserved':52,'eval_events_retained':51,'warmup_events_retained':len(unscored),'scored_events':len(pred),'primary_scored_events':22,'earlier_scored_events':17,'fits_per_model_family':39,'new_fitted_model_families':4,'new_model_fits':156,'parameter_grids':0,'new_labels':0,'label_rows_read':51,'primary_gates':gates,'primary_increment_gate_passed':passed,'model_errors':errors,'opportunity_summary':sums,'annual_natural_opportunities':annual,'primary_new_entry_dates':new_dates,'primary_high_score_actual_paths_using_added_fields':int(primary_joint.added_fields_on_actual_path.sum()),'same_baseline_and_joint_training_event_ids':True,'new_full_accounts':0,'account_status':'NOT_RUN_PENDING_SEPARATE_ACCOUNT_PROTOCOL' if passed else 'NOT_RUN_FIXED_PRIMARY_SIGNAL_INCREMENT_GATE_FAILED','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','diagnosis':'固定信号增量门失败。标签已包含原费用；未作费用减免和账户约束反事实，不能把失败归咎风险上限或交易成本。' if not passed else '信号门通过尚非费用后完整账户绩效；风险/自然年频率/成交现金账另核。','source_code_edits':0,'new_downloads':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'limits':['公开当前版本，首版未认证，公告EOD研究时钟假设','已见原根目录而非完整全国月份档案','39次评分/22主要期，开发结果而非独立验证','份额和原期长是结构信息，上游调整原因仍UNKNOWN','固定10000份机会标签，不是200000或20000账户']}
save('result.json',result)
print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'primary_gates':gates,'all_passed':passed,'new_entry_dates':new_dates,'summary':sums,'primary_errors':primary_errors,'annual_natural_opportunities':annual},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
